item.title: NATO Fighter Jet Downs Drone in Romania Near Ukraine Border
item.description: This marks another in a series of incidents involving drone incursions into NATO airspace from Ukraine.

item.title: Anne Hathaway and Bob Iger to receive 2026 Disney Legends Awards
item.description: Disney's top honor recognizes stars, storytellers, and leaders across the company.

item.title: Hurricane Lala, Category 1, brings heavy rain and flooding to Hawaii
item.description: Lala strengthened to a Category 1 hurricane as it moved through the central Pacific, approaching the Big Island on Saturday.

item.title: Suspect in Virginia State shooting arrested in dorm closet, police say
item.description: A suspect in the early Saturday shooting at Virginia State University that wounded five, one critically, has been arrested.
